last_episode_to_air.name: Episode 95 (Final)
last_episode_to_air.overview: An unidentified body found in a container; Metin and Eren standing over the body... İnci and Engin who came to the courthouse to celebrate Ceylin's birthday... Ilgaz Kaya, the prosecutor who was called to the scene; who quietly passed by the Ceylins... Everyone is as they should be, as they are remembered; but everything is different... This time Ceylin and Ilgaz are suspects in the same murder! Ceylin and Ilgaz are a couple who have been brought together by many family secrets around a murder! A love story tied with invisible threads that tighten and tighten as they untie the knots... A corpse that appears in their garden in the city where they go to start a brand new life, as if to underline that they cannot escape their fate... Perhaps a curse... Do two souls searching for each other, unaware of each other for a lifetime, always intersect at some place, at some time? Does everything end where it begins? Or does everything begin in order to end?

name: Family Secrets
overview: Ceylin is a fierce, rule-bending defence attorney whose father was wrongly imprisoned — for her, justice always comes before the law. Ilgaz is a by-the-book prosecutor who believes the two are the same thing. When his brother is accused of murder, he has no choice but to go to her for help. What follows is a gripping cat-and-mouse legal thriller built on brilliant opposing chemistry — winner of the International Emmy for Best Telenovela in 2023.
